messages.subject: Sutherland v Vantage - disclosure deadline
messages.plaintextBody: Sarah - quick one on the Sutherland Logistics litigation (not Indigo): the standard disclosure deadline is 6 March and we're still chasing Vantage's solicitors at Marlowe Greaves for their list. Can we grab ten minutes tomorrow on the e-disclosure platform before I write to them? Tom
